QF.id: Introduction to AML, CFT and Proliferation Financing_2

question.text: In the money laundering process, the stage where illegally obtained funds are first introduced into the financial system is known as:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the NISM Series XXIV AML/CFT workbook (p.12, confirmed in the p.20 sample question), placement is Stage 1 of the three-stage money-laundering process and is when illegally obtained funds are first introduced into the financial system. The Trap: "Layering" is Stage 2 (moving funds through complex transactions). The workbook's Stage 3 is listed as "Integration / extraction" — so "Extraction" is not the stage at which funds are first introduced. "Integration" likewise refers to Stage 3, not the initial introduction. Note: Remember the workbook's exact labeling: Stage 1 Placement, Stage 2 Layering, Stage 3 Integration / extraction.
